description: Land Aquisition - Walaswewa, Galewela D/S Division, Matara District (25/0046)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific land parcel details, ownership declarations, cadastral map references, and land settlement determinations for multiple properties in Walaswewa and Tholabugolla villages. The content falls squarely under "Land Gazettes" as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels with detailed technical information about each property.
